note: A class is a weapon type, fixed per merc. Each class has a line of weapons (items with the same class); a merc only carries weapons of their own class. base_item is what they start with.

rifle.name: Rifleman
rifle.summary: Balanced and reliable at any range.

sniper.name: Marksman
sniper.summary: Reaches far and lands more often.

shotgun.name: Breacher
shotgun.summary: Brutal up close, weak at range.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.summary: Slow, heavy hits. The line ends in a minigun that fires bursts.

grenade.name: Grenadier
grenade.summary: Splash damage on a tile and its neighbours.

beam.name: Laser gunner
beam.summary: Cuts through low cover and loses nothing to range.
